name: Parmesan & Parsley Crusted Chicken with Roasted Romaine Lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper. Place on a baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Grate ¾ cup of Parmesan cheese. Peel and mince garlic.
In a medium bowl, combine parsley, Parmesan, garlic, bread crumbs, and olive oil. Mix well and pat onto chicken fillets.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup gluten-free bread crumbs
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in the oven and bake while you prepare the romaine, about 5 minutes.
Wash and dry lettuce. Quarter lengthwise. Place on sheet with chicken and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads romaine lettuce
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return sheet to the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and romaine is browned at the edges, another 5-10 minutes.
To serve, place chicken and romaine hearts on a plate. Garnish with lemon wedges and sprinkle romaine hearts with pine nuts. Enjoy!
